transcript.text: During my review of the court docket, I located a stipulated protective order entered on April 3, 2025. It has three key requirements: (1) factual interview summaries must be produced by May 20, 2025; (2) attorney mental impressions and legal analysis may be withheld; and (3) a confidentiality designation must accompany the production. The docket alert was routed only to the litigation queue, so these requirements have not yet been added to the response draft. This means our draft needs to be updated to comply with the protective order — particularly, we should withhold any attorney mental impressions and legal analysis from the investigative analyses currently in the package, ensure factual interview summaries are produced by the May 20 deadline, and add the required confidentiality designation to the production.
transcript.speaker: A2

commitments.detail: Revise the draft response package to withhold attorney mental impressions and legal analysis from the investigative analyses, ensure factual interview summaries are produced by the May 20, 2025 deadline, and add the required confidentiality designation per the April 3, 2025 stipulated protective order.
Redact the reporting employee's identity from all materials in the production package in accordance with the signed compliance request.
Implement exactly 90 days of independent retaliation monitoring as required by the reporting employee's signed request in the compliance system.
Establish a cross-functional workflow so that compliance intake requests and litigation docket alerts are both reviewed and incorporated into subpoena response packages before final approval.
